IDENT.title: Real-time order dispatching for a fleet of autonomous mobile robots using multi-agent reinforcement learning

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: learning agents are decision-making units representing AMR vehicles and interacting with the learning environment
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: learning agents are decision-making units representing AMR vehicles and interacting with the learning environment

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: learning agents are decision-making units representing AMR vehicles

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: Each agent has its own policy which is a mapping from observations to actions.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: The agent’s actions are bid values that the agent proposes to the environment for the observed order.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: this implies that the approach can be scaled to an arbitrary number of AMRs

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: Each agent receives its own observation and reward, and then responds back to the learning environment with its selected action.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: The RL framework was implemented using the RLlib library

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: TD3 is an actor-critic algorithm for continuous action space, that concurrently approximates two Q-functions and a policy using neural networks.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Neural network policy/critic weights; observation includes assigned order count and last order end location
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: ni is the number of orders currently assigned to the agent.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: The observations are given to the agents only when an order is ready for despatch.

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: An agent’s observation is a partial representation of the global state.

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote: The learned policy is then transferred to a physics-based simulation of the AMR ﬂeet

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: The training is carried out using a fast, simpliﬁed simulation.

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: which in turn permits the agents to have shorter memory for learning

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: Each agent receives its own observation and reward, and then responds back to the learning environment with its selected action.

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: AMR agents learn to bid on orders based on their individual observations

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: The Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic (TD3) policy gradient algorithm [14] is suggested.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: The approach is validated using a physics-based AMR simulation.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: they receive a penalty that increases quadratically with tardiness

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: compared to the random policy, that assigns the order to a randomly selected free AMR, and to the closest-ﬁrst policy

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: Transport order arrivals are modelled as a Poisson process with arrival rate λ.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: A ﬂeet of ﬁve AMRs was simulated.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: Based on the actions of the agents, movement destinations are passed to the AMRs, which, in turn, perform the transports.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Resource (AMR) agents learn bidding policies via multi-agent RL (TD3) with shared rewards; no product agents, no formal model or capability discovery; bids routed through a central learning environment.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: all AMR agents receive the same rewards or penalties for each completed order

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: The reward mechanism needs to be designed so that it encourages cooperation between the agents.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: A ﬂeet of ﬁve AMRs was simulated.
